title: Valheim World Editor mod manifest (worldeditor.json)
description: What a Valheim mod tells the Valheim World Editor about itself. See docs/modding.md.

data.description: By data key, as the mod's code names it.

label.description: How the inspector names the value.

readOnly.description: The inspector shows the value but does not let it be changed.

help.description: What the value is, shown when pointing at it.

extension.description: The mod's editor extension: a DLL, relative to this file's folder and inside it. Runs once the player allows it (Settings, Mod extensions); an add-on's runs as installed.

serves.description: An add-on's only (a file in the addons folder next to the editor): the file name of the mod's DLL it is for. The add-on is used while that DLL is in a plugins folder; without it, always.

gameComponents.description: Class names of the game's scripts whose fields the extension reads (IEditorHost.Game): read from the player's Valheim while the extension runs.

settingsFiles.description: File names of the mod's BepInEx settings files the extension reads (IEditorHost.Setting), in BepInEx/config: the connected game's own while live, else the player's.

links.description: How the mod links its objects into one (a ship and its pieces): each rule's keys are data keys, as the mod's code names them.

name.description: What one group is called in the editor's messages (default: group).

id.description: Int data key of an object's own id, which its parts name.

parents.description: Int data keys naming what a part hangs on, the first one set winning.

offset.description: Vec3 data key of a part's place in the frame of what it hangs on, in metres.

rotation.description: Vec3 data key of a part's turn in that frame, Unity Euler degrees.

rotationQuaternion.description: Quaternion data key of that turn, used when rotation is not stored.

storedAt.description: Where the game saves a part: at its group's root (default) or where it stands.

references.description: Other int data keys naming an object's id: a pasted copy's follow the new ids.

dropOnCopy.description: Data keys a pasted copy leaves out.

hidden.description: Not offered in Place or the Workshop's Build panel.

group.description: The heading the piece is listed under in the Build panel's Mods tab.

data.description: Objects of it only hold the mod's data: never drawn, picked or listed, kept by a zone reset that keeps the buildings.
